claims.statement: Wrote on the sixteen Xining chieftain houses.
Asked that chieftains keep hereditary offices.
Came over early in the Ming.

label.en: Governor-General Qiao Fang of Meng asked that they continue to hold their former offices by hereditary grant.
label.zh: 孟總督喬芳請仍錫以原職世襲。

label.en: Early in the Ming he was made grand marshal of the Shaanxi pacification commission; he followed the great general Xu Da in winning over the eighteen tribes of T
label.zh: 明初，授陝西平章宣慰使司都元帥，隨大將軍徐達招撫十八族鐵城、岷山等處，賜姓趙，更名安，授臨洮衛土官指揮同知，

label.en: In the tenth year of Zhengtong he died, and his son Ying inherited the post.
label.zh: 正統十年，卒，子英襲。

label.en: In the twentieth year of Guangxu, he inherited the post and received a new patent from the Ministry of War.
label.zh: 光緒二十年，襲職，領兵部號紙。

label.en: Impressed by Yuanming's courage, He put him in command of the Weiding vanguard and posted him at Huangjiatan south of the city.
label.zh: 何以元銘勇，委帶威定前營，駐城南黃家灘。

label.en: He won repeated victories at Bianjiawan, Sanjiaji, Luoshenmiao, and elsewhere, raised the siege of Hezhou, and was granted a second-rank brevet rank and a title
label.zh: 於邊家灣、三家集、羅神廟等處屢捷，解河州圍，加二品銜勇號。

label.en: Under the Yuan he held the post of grand marshal of the Shaanxi pacification commission.
label.zh: 元授陝西平章宣慰使司都元帥。

label.en: Early in the Ming he came over, received the surname He, and was made hereditary native commander of Hezhou Guard.
label.zh: 明初，投誠，賜姓何，授河州衛土官指揮。

label.en: In the fifth year, during the Muslim revolt, his son Yangwei led troops with distinction, and the family petitioned for a hereditary patent of appointment.
label.zh: 五年，回變，其子揚威帶兵有功，請給號紙世襲。

label.en: By the Qianlong reign Zhao Wu inherited the post.
label.zh: 至乾隆年，趙武襲。

label.en: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, religious rebels entered Gansu from Sichuan; Wu was then ill and sent his son Dachen to hold Xiage Beach below Jinggu City on the
label.zh: 嘉慶四年，教匪由川入甘，時武患病，委子大臣在南界景古城瞎歌灘防堵。

label.en: In the fourth year of Guangxu he inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒四年，襲職。

label.en: Han Hama held the native chieftaincy of Hezhou Guard under the Yuan and Ming.
label.zh: 韓哈麻，元、明時，授河州衛土司。

label.en: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong, Hezhou issued a commission as native chiliarch, and his son Ting inherited the post.
label.zh: 乾隆十四年，河州發給土千戶委牌，子霆襲。

label.en: Later, during the Yancha Muslim revolt, he distinguished himself in defense, and Governor-General Fukang'an granted him a sub-chieftain's patent.
label.zh: 繼鹽茶回變，防禦有功，總督福康安給土司外委劄付。

label.en: There was also Han Wanbu, who held the hereditary commandership.
label.zh: 又有韓完卜者，世襲指揮使。

label.en: Later, because Han Qianguan had lost his patent seal, he was appointed a sub-chieftain.
label.zh: 其後韓千貫以劄印遺失，授為外委土司。

label.en: Under Yongzheng, Han Shigong held the passes without loss when hostile tribes rose, and was restored to the commandership.
label.zh: 雍正間，韓世公因逆夷跳樑，把隘無失，仍授指揮使。

label.en: When Wen died, his son Chenglín inherited the post.
label.zh: 雯卒，子成璘襲。

label.en: In the eleventh year of Xianfeng Han Tingzuo inherited the post.
label.zh: 咸豐十一年，韓廷佐襲。

label.en: In the Zhizheng era of the Yuan, for defending the nine tribes of Hadachuan, he received a commandership and established his house at Minzhou Guard.
label.zh: 元至正間，因防守哈達川九族，授指揮使職，家岷州衛。

label.en: His son Zhen received a hereditary native centurionship in the Hongwu reign for his services.
label.zh: 子珍，明洪武間，以功授世襲土官百戶。

label.en: In the second year of Shunzhi, Ma Guodong submitted and was confirmed in his former post.
label.zh: 清順治二年，馬國棟歸附，授原職。

label.en: Cheng's son Zhang won distinction campaigning against Ü-Tsang in the Chenghua reign and received a hereditary native centurionship.
label.zh: 成子璋，成化間，征烏斯藏有功，授世襲土官百戶。

label.en: Early in the Qing, Hou Chengqing came over from within and was made a sub-centurion.
label.zh: 清初，後承慶內附，為外委百戶。

label.en: In the thirtieth year of Kangxi he received a patent commission to take office.
label.zh: 康熙三十年，劄委任事。

label.en: In the ninth year of Qianlong, Yongqing's grandson Fakui was at last formally appointed native centurion.
label.zh: 乾隆九年，永慶孫發葵始實授土百戶。

label.en: In the Hongwu reign he received a hereditary native centurionship.
label.zh: 明洪武間，授世襲土官百戶。

label.en: Early in the Qing, Zhao Yingchen came over and was made a sub-native official.
label.zh: 清初，趙應臣內附，為外委土官。

label.en: In the twenty-first year of Kangxi his son Zhiding was restored to the original post.
label.zh: 康熙二十一年，授其子之鼎原職。

label.en: In the twenty-eighth year of Hongwu he received a hereditary native centurionship for his services.
label.zh: 明洪武二十八年，以功授世襲土官百戶。

label.en: Under Shunzhi, Hou Xikui submitted and was made a sub-centurion.
label.zh: 清順治間，後希魁歸附，授外委百戶。

label.en: Xikui's great-grandson Rongchang was formally appointed native centurion.
label.zh: 希魁曾孫榮昌，實授土百戶。

label.en: Early in Guangxu, Hou Zhenxing was transferred to the hereditary native platoon-leader post.
label.zh: 光緒初，後振興改襲土把總。

label.en: In the Xuande reign he received the post of native vice-chiliarch.
label.zh: 明宣德間，授土官副千戶。

label.en: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi his cousin Hongyuan distinguished himself in recovering Taozhou and Minzhou during Wu Sangui's rebellion; Zhang Yong, the marqu
label.zh: 康熙十四年，其堂弟宏元於吳逆之變，恢復洮、岷有功，靖逆侯張勇題敘，仍授世襲副千戶。

label.en: In the sixteenth year he received the post of native vice-commander.
label.zh: 十六年，授土官指揮僉事。

label.en: In the Zhengde reign his great-grandson Wangxiu was called to the capital for audience and given the name Yang Hong.
label.zh: 正德間，玄孫旺秀調京引見，賜姓名楊洪。

label.en: The line came down to Yang Chaoliang, who submitted in the eighteenth year of Shunzhi, received a patent to manage native affairs, and held the rank of sub-chie
label.zh: 傳至楊朝樑，於順治十八年歸附，仍給劄管理土務，為外委土司。

label.en: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, during Wu Sangui's rebellion, he supplied the armies and was granted the Mongol title Baitalabuleha fan, with permission for t
label.zh: 康熙十四年，吳三桂亂，助餉，授拜他喇布勒哈番，准襲二次。

label.en: In the twentieth year Chaoliang's son Wei inherited the post.
label.zh: 二十年，朝樑子威襲。

label.en: In the forty-fifth year Wei's son Rusong inherited the post.
label.zh: 四十五年，威子汝松襲。

label.en: Rusong's son Chongxiao continued to hold the vice-commandership by inheritance.
label.zh: 汝松子沖霄，仍襲指揮僉事。

label.en: His great-grandson Zongye inherited the post.
label.zh: 曾孫宗業襲職。

label.en: In the nineteenth year of Jiaqing, Zongye's younger brother Zongji inherited the post and also served as registrar of Chanding Temple.
label.zh: 嘉慶十九年，宗業弟宗基襲，兼攝禪定寺僧綱。

label.en: Zongji's son Yuan inherited the post in the twenty-fourth year of Daoguang.
label.zh: 宗基子元，道光二十四年襲。

label.en: In the sixth year of Guangxu his son Zuolin inherited the post, received the first-rank cap button for military service, held the War Ministry patent, and also
label.zh: 光緒六年，子作霖襲職，亦以軍功得頭品頂戴，領兵部號紙，兼攝護國禪師。

label.en: Zuolin's great-grandson Jiqing inherited the post in the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu.
label.zh: 作霖曾孫積慶，光緒二十八年襲。

label.en: The Zhengde grant of the surname Yang had by then faded into obscurity.
label.zh: 明正德賜姓之事，則已茫如矣。

label.en: In the nineteenth year he followed Commander Ma Yu against Diezhou and, for his services, received a hereditary centurionship in the guard's central chiliarch's
label.zh: 十九年，隨指揮馬煜征疊州，以功授本衛世襲中千戶所百戶。

label.en: His son Bo'erjie inherited the post in the twentieth year of Hongwu.
label.zh: 子卜爾結，於洪武二十年襲。

label.en: In the third year of Yongle he received the surname Zan.
label.zh: 永樂三年，賜姓昝。

label.en: In the fifth year of Xuande, for escorting the envoy Hou Xian, he was promoted to full centurion of the guard.
label.zh: 宣德五年，以護送侯顯功，升本衛實授百戶。

label.en: He held a patent from the Taozhou military-civilian command; Zan Tianxi inherited in the twentieth year of Guangxu.
label.zh: 奉洮州衛軍民指揮使司劄付，昝天錫於光緒二十年承襲。

label.en: Yongluzhalaxiao was a tribesman of the Zhuoxun people under Taozhou Guard; in the Yongle reign he received a native centurionship for his services.
label.zh: 永魯劄剌肖，洮州衛著遜族番人，明永樂間，以功授土官百戶。

label.en: The line came down to Yong Zixin, who submitted under Shunzhi and inherited the post.
label.zh: 傳至永子新，清順治間，歸附，襲職。

label.en: Yong Long inherited the post in the twenty-fifth year of Guangxu.
label.zh: 永隆於光緒二十五年承襲。

label.en: He was first enfeoffed as Marquis of the Gold and Purple Ten Thousand Households and for generations guarded the western frontier.
label.zh: 初封金紫萬戶侯，世守西土。

label.en: In the fifth year he pacified the western Tibetans and was made vice-chiliarch.
label.zh: 五年，招撫西番，授副千戶。

label.en: He fell pursuing western Tibetan rebels at Yilin Zhenhui; his son Suonan inherited the post.
label.zh: 以追剿西番亦林真卉陣亡，子鎖南襲。

label.en: The line came down to Qi Tingjian, who inherited the post.
label.zh: 傳至祁廷諫，襲職。

label.en: In the second year of Shunzhi Prince Regent Ajige reached Xi'an, routed the rebels, recovered Tingjian, rewarded him with robes, horse, silks, and silver, sent
label.zh: 清順治二年，英親王阿濟格至西安，破走逆闖，得廷諫，賞衣帽、鞍馬、采緞、銀兩，令回西寧安撫番族，仍授本衛指揮使，世襲。

label.en: Xingzhou had earlier won appointment as colonel of Dajing Camp for his fighting; he now inherited the commandership.
label.zh: 興周先以戰功授大靖營參將，至是襲職。

claims.statement: Fought for the Prince of Yan.

label.en: In the seventh year of Hongwu he followed Li Wenzhong north with distinction and was made campaign vice-commander.
label.zh: 洪武七年，隨李文忠北伐有功，授隨征指揮僉事。

label.en: Yi inherited his father's post and was transferred to the Right Guard of Yan Mountain.
label.zh: 義襲父職，調任燕山右護衛。

label.en: When the war for the throne began, he fought for the Prince of Yan and was promoted to assistant commander of Luzhou Guard in Shanxi.
label.zh: 靖難兵起，從燕王轉戰，升山西潞州衛指揮同知。

label.en: He soon escorted the Yongle Emperor against Muyashili, pursued the enemy to Hongshan Pass, and was promoted to commander.
label.zh: 旋扈成祖征木雅失里，逐北至紅山口，遷指揮使。

label.en: He then followed Geng Bingwen in garrisoning Gansu and received the hereditary commandership of Xining Guard.
label.zh: 又從耿炳文駐防甘肅，授西寧衛世襲指揮使。

label.en: In the fourth year of Guangxu his son Yingchun inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒四年，子迎春襲。

label.en: The line came down to Li Hongyuan, who inherited the assistant commandership.
label.zh: 傳至李洪遠，襲指揮同知職。

label.en: In the eighth year of Xianfeng Li Erchang inherited the post.
label.zh: 咸豐八年，李爾昌襲。

label.en: In the fourth year of Hongwu he submitted and was made chief banner officer.
label.zh: 明洪武四年，投誠，授總旗。

label.en: In the first year of Tongzhi, Governor-General Shen Zhaolin campaigned against the Salars; Na Chaozhen was ordered to hold Nanchuan Shizhangjia.
label.zh: 同治元年，總督沈兆霖督軍進討撒回，納朝珍奉檄守南川什張加。

label.en: In the fourth year of Guangxu, Chaozhen's son Yannian inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒四年，朝珍子延年襲。

label.en: He rose through posts to vice-chiliarch of the Left Golden Crow Guard's central company and then to vice-commander.
label.zh: 累除金吾左衛中衛所副千戶，加指揮僉事。

label.en: In the nineteenth year of Guangxu his son Zushu inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒十九年，子祖述襲。

label.en: In the fourth year of Hongwu he submitted and was made centurion.
label.zh: 洪武四年，投誠，授百戶。

label.en: His son Duo'erzhi inherited the post.
label.zh: 子朵爾只襲。

label.en: In the twelfth year he was restored to the vice-commandership.
label.zh: 十二年，仍襲指揮僉事。

label.en: In the third year of Hongwu he submitted and received the hereditary rank of Zhaoxin Colonel with command of a centurion.
label.zh: 明洪武三年，投誠，授世襲昭信校尉管軍百戶職銜。

label.en: The line came down to Han Yuchang, who submitted under Kangxi and received from Pacification General Zhang of Jingning a colonel's commission.
label.zh: 傳至韓愈昌，清康熙間，歸附，蒙靖甯將軍張劄委都司職銜。

label.en: His son Bing pacified the frontier tribes with distinction; under Yongzheng he received the War Ministry patent, became native chiliarch, and governed the Han S
label.zh: 子炳，撫番有功，於雍正間奉兵部號紙，襲土千戶，管西鄉上四工韓姓撒拉。

label.en: Han Shaban, in Ming times, pacified the frontier tribes and received a hereditary Salar centurionship.
label.zh: 韓沙班，明時，撫番有功，授世襲撒拉族土百戶。

label.en: Wang Guozhu, native centurion of Qizang, submitted in the second year of Shunzhi and was confirmed in his post over the frontier peoples.
label.zh: 癿藏土百戶王國柱，清順治二年，歸附，授原職，管番民。

label.en: In the first year of Qianlong he was appointed hereditary native chiliarch of Datong River for his services.
label.zh: 乾隆元年，以功補大通川土千戶，世襲。

label.en: In the sixth year he was appointed hereditary vice-commander of Xining Guard.
label.zh: 六年，授西寧衛指揮僉事。

label.en: His son Duanzhu inherited the post.
label.zh: 子端竹襲。

label.en: His son Qizhen inherited the office and was the first to adopt Qi as the family surname.
label.zh: 子祁震襲，始以祁為氏。

label.en: Bingzhong's nephew Guoping inherited the post of assistant commander.
label.zh: 秉忠侄國屏，襲都指揮同知，

label.en: In the ninth year he was confirmed as hereditary assistant commander of Xining Guard.
label.zh: 九年，授西寧衛世襲指揮同知。

label.en: His son Bozhi inherited the post.
label.zh: 子伯豸襲。

label.en: When the Emperor personally marched against Galdan, Zhongzhi accompanied the campaign, was promoted to acting regional commander of Wenzhou, and then returned h
label.zh: 聖祖親征噶爾丹、仲豸扈從，擢署溫州鎮總兵，回籍以原官署理指揮同知印務。

label.en: In the eleventh year of Guangxu his son Guiyu inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒十一年，子貴玉襲。

label.en: At the beginning of the Hongwu reign he submitted and was granted the hereditary post of vice-commander.
label.zh: 明洪武初，投誠，授指揮僉事世襲。

label.en: In the fifth year of Yongle he died, and his son Ying inherited the post.
label.zh: 永樂五年，卒，子英襲。

label.en: On his arrival he was promoted to left commander-in-chief of the Right Guard.
label.zh: 既至，擢右府左都督。

label.en: In the second year of Xuande he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Huining with an emolument of eleven hundred shi, and Nange was posthumously granted the rank of visc
label.zh: 宣德二年，封會寧伯，祿千一百石，並贈南哥子爵。

label.en: Ningxia Regional Commander Shi Zhao reported that Ying harbored disloyal ambitions. Ying submitted a memorial in his own defense and received an imperial edict
label.zh: 寧夏總兵史昭奏英有異志，英上章辯，賜敕慰諭之。

label.en: Ying established his household at Xining, took in more than seven hundred fugitive families, set up estates to open farmland, and forcibly seized others' proper
label.zh: 英家西寧，招逋逃七百餘戶，置莊墾田，豪奪人產，復為兵部及言官所劾，追逃者入官。

label.en: In the second year of Shunzhi, Prince Yin Ajige reached Guanzhong and the roving rebels dispersed. Tianyu presented himself to the prince, who granted him robes
label.zh: 清順治二年，英親王阿濟格至關中，流寇潰散，天俞謁王，王賜衣冠、鞍馬、銀兩、彩緞，令回西寧招撫番族。

label.en: In the tenth year he was granted the hereditary post of assistant commander of Xining Guard.
label.zh: 十年，授西寧衛指揮同知，世襲。

label.en: Shu and his younger brother Qia mustered more than five hundred boatmen and built over fifty rafts each. They ferried government troops across at Xincheng River
label.zh: 澍與弟洽預調水夫五百餘名，各造木筏五十餘只，由新城河口宵濟官軍，並率土兵千餘騎繼進，遂復蘭州、臨鞏諸城，擢遊擊。

label.en: The line passed to Li Changnian, who inherited the post in the fourth year of Guangxu.
label.zh: 傳至李長年，光緒四年，襲職。

label.en: In the eighteenth year he was confirmed in the hereditary post of assistant commander.
label.zh: 十八年，仍襲指揮同知。

label.en: In the seventh year of Guangxu Yongling inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒七年，永齡襲職。

label.en: At the beginning of the Hongwu reign he submitted and was appointed petty bannerman.
label.zh: 明洪武初，投誠，選充小旗。

label.en: His son Aji inherited the petty bannerman's post and was the first to adopt A as the family surname.
label.zh: 子阿吉襲小旗，始以阿為氏。

label.en: He accompanied Emperor Chengzu on the northern expedition against Aruqtai, distinguished himself at the Battle of Kuelie'er River, and was promoted to chief ban
label.zh: 扈成祖北征阿魯台，戰魁列兒河有功，遷總旗。

label.en: In the ninth year of Guangxu Wenxuan's son Baoheng inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒九年，文選子保衡襲。

label.en: In the twentieth year Baoheng's son Chengdong inherited the post.
label.zh: 二十年，保衡子成棟襲。

label.en: In the fourth year of Hongwu he submitted and was confirmed in his former post.
label.zh: 洪武四年，投誠，授原職。

label.en: His son Dadu followed Regional Commander Song Sheng in suppressing rebellious western fan bandits, won a victory, and was promoted to chiliarch.
label.zh: 子大都，從都督宋晟討西番叛賊，獲捷遷千戶。

label.en: In the seventh year of Yongle he died. His son Gansu inherited the post and was the first to adopt Gan as the family surname.
label.zh: 永樂七年，卒，子甘肅襲職，始以甘為氏。

label.en: In the sixteenth year of Chongzhen roving rebels harassed Xining. Gan Jizu's household was looted and the patent documents confirming hereditary succession were
label.zh: 崇禎十六年，流寇擾西寧，甘繼祖家被掠，失承襲號紙。

label.en: For his recorded merit he was restored to his original hereditary post of vice-commander.
label.zh: 敘功，襲指揮僉事原職。

label.en: Gan Zhongying inherited the post in the fourth year of Guangxu.
label.zh: 甘鍾英，光緒四年襲。

label.en: In the fourth year of Hongwu he submitted and was appointed petty bannerman.
label.zh: 明洪武四年，投誠，充小旗。

label.en: In the twentieth year he again accompanied Chengzu on the northern expedition, defeated the enemy at Kuelie'er River, and was promoted to chiliarch.
label.zh: 二十年，再扈成祖北征，敗賊於魁列兒河，擢千戶。

label.en: His son Zhu Rong inherited the post and was the first to adopt Zhu as the family surname.
label.zh: 子硃榮襲職，始以硃為氏。

label.en: In the fortieth year of Kangxi he was again granted the hereditary post of vice-commander.
label.zh: 康熙四十年，仍授指揮僉事，世襲。

label.en: In the eleventh year of Guangxu Xie's son Tingzuo inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒十一年，協子廷佐襲。

label.en: In the fourth year of Hongwu he submitted and was appointed petty bannerman.
label.zh: 明洪武四年，投誠，授小旗。

label.en: His son Yelizhi succeeded to the post. In the first year of Hongxi he distinguished himself in the campaign against the Anding bandits and was promoted to garri
label.zh: 子也裏只補役，洪熙元年，從征安定賊有功，擢所鎮撫。

label.en: His son Yeshanshe inherited the post.
label.zh: 子也陝舍襲。

label.en: In the second year of Shunzhi, Ye Ding submitted, and the hereditary grant was confirmed.
label.zh: 順治二年，冶鼎歸附，仍予世襲。

label.en: In the second year of Shunzhi he submitted and was appointed centurion.
label.zh: 清順治二年，歸附，授職百戶，

label.en: In the fifteenth year of Guangxu, Li Changgeng inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒十五年，李長庚襲。

label.en: His son Qishigou succeeded to the post.
label.zh: 子七十狗補役。

label.en: In the second year of Shunzhi, Xin Weiding submitted and was confirmed as probationary centurion.
label.zh: 清順治二年，辛偉鼎歸附，仍授試百戶職。

label.en: Yuhou inherited the post.
label.zh: 裕後襲。

label.en: His son Xuetielijia succeeded to the post and, for his services, was appointed centurion.
label.zh: 子薛帖里加替役，以功授百戶。

label.en: His son Laku inherited the post, won promotion to vice-chiliarch for his services, and adopted La as the family surname.
label.zh: 子喇苦襲，以功升副千戶，遂以喇為氏。

label.en: His father Toghan was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuding and also held the post of grand chancellor.
label.zh: 父脫歡，封武定王，兼平章政事。

label.en: In the fourth year of Hongwu he brought his sons and tribes to allegiance. The founding emperor made Gongbushijia a company leader and settled his people at Zhu
label.zh: 明洪武四年，率諸子部落投誠，太祖授鞏卜失加為百夫長，俾統所部居莊浪，以功升百戶。

label.en: At the beginning of the Yongle reign he was killed in the campaign against Aruqtai. The line passed to his son Shijia, who repeatedly served as assistant comman
label.zh: 永樂初，殉阿魯台之難，傳子失加，累署莊浪衛指揮同知，賜姓魯氏。

label.en: In the tenth year of Chongzhen, Jing's great-grandson Yinchang was made deputy regional commander of Xining.
label.zh: 崇禎十年，以經曾孫印昌任西寧副總兵。

label.en: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi, Yinchang's son Hong submitted, inherited the commandership, and received an imperial patent with seal.
label.zh: 清順治十六年，印昌子宏歸附，襲指揮使，錫之敕印。

label.en: When his exploit was reported, he was given an honorary promotion of one rank and awarded the peacock feather.
label.zh: 事聞，加一等職銜、花翎。

label.en: His legitimate grandson Rugao inherited the post.
label.zh: 嫡孫如皋襲。

label.en: In the seventh year, when a mint was built in the provincial capital, he donated tens of thousands of logs from his mountain domain and was rewarded with a seco
label.zh: 七年，省城修建錢局，捐本管山場木植數萬株，加二品頂戴、花翎。

label.en: At the beginning of Tongzhi, during the Muslim revolt, he was awarded the honorary rank of deputy general for his services.
label.zh: 同治初，回亂，以功加副將銜。

label.en: In the thirteenth year, when Xining was cleared of rebels, he received the honorary rank of regional commander and the title Yuyong Batulu.
label.zh: 十三年，西寧肅清，加提督銜、譽勇巴圖魯，

label.en: From Tao's generation upward, the Lu clan held the hereditary seal as native chieftain commanders, stationed at Zhuanglang and charged with the defense of Lianc
label.zh: 魯氏自燾以上，世襲掌印土司指揮使，駐紮莊浪，分守連城。

label.en: In the fourth year of Hongwu he followed his father in submission, was made vice-commander, and later received the surname Lu.
label.zh: 明洪武四年，隨父來降，授指揮僉事，後賜姓魯氏。

label.en: Governor-General Meng Qiao Fang of Shaanxi commended his services and appointed him acting brigade commander of Zhenhai Camp to join the main army in the puniti
label.zh: 陝西總督孟喬芳嘉其功，委署鎮海營參將，隨大軍征剿。

label.en: In the third year of Tongzhi, when Muslims rebelled, Xuzhou led his men against the rebels and was killed in battle. His son Xi inherited the post.
label.zh: 同治三年，回變，緒周率所部禦賊，陣亡，子熹襲職。

label.en: In the eleventh year of Guangxu his son Fuxi inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒十一年，子服西襲職。

label.en: From Fuxi's generation upward, the family held the hereditary seal as native chieftain vice-commanders.
label.zh: 自服西以上，世襲掌印土司指揮僉事。

label.en: Under the Ming he served as a military dependent on campaign and was made chief banner officer.
label.zh: 明時，以官舍隨征，授總旗。

label.en: In the second year of Shunzhi, Lu Dagao submitted with Lu Xisheng and others and was confirmed in his former post.
label.zh: 清順治二年，魯大誥隨魯希聖等歸附，仍授前職。

label.en: In the nineteenth year of Guangxu, Lu Zhantai inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒十九年，魯瞻泰襲。

label.en: From Zhantai's generation upward the family had lived at Gucheng and held the hereditary native commandership.
label.zh: 自泰以上，世居古城，襲土指揮使。

label.en: Under the Ming the family held the hereditary native deputy commandership.
label.zh: 明時，世襲土指揮副使。

label.en: In the eighteenth year of Guangxu, Lu Weili inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒十八年，魯維禮襲職。

label.en: From Weili's generation upward the family had lived at Dayingwan and held the hereditary native deputy commandership.
label.zh: 自維禮以上，世居大營灣，襲土指揮副使。

label.en: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, Lu Yingxuan inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒十七年，魯應選襲職。

label.en: The family had lived for generations at the Xidatong Pass and held the hereditary native assistant commandership.
label.zh: 世居西大通峽口，襲土指揮同知。

label.en: His son Jingcheng inherited the hereditary full chiliarchship.
label.zh: 子景成，仍襲正千戶世職。

label.en: In the fifth year of Guangxu, Lu Fushan inherited the post.
label.zh: 光緒五年，魯福山襲。

label.en: Under the Ming the family held the hereditary vice-chiliarchship.
label.zh: 明世襲副千戶。

label.en: Lu Zheng inherited the post.
label.zh: 魯政襲職。

label.en: His son Chenfu inherited the post.
label.zh: 子臣福襲。

label.en: In the ninth year he was restored to the hereditary assistant commandership.
label.zh: 九年，復襲指揮同知。

label.en: Lu Chabo held the rank of full centurion under the Ming.
label.zh: 魯察伯，明實授百戶。

label.en: In the sixteenth year of Kangxi, his son Lu Xiang inherited the full centurionship.
label.zh: 康熙十六年，子魯襄，仍襲實授百戶。

label.en: Shichen's son Long inherited his father's post.
label.zh: 世臣子龍襲前職。

label.en: In the ninth year he was confirmed in the hereditary vice-commandership.
label.zh: 九年，仍襲指揮僉事。
